question: free_tier.stated of ip-proxy/thespeedx-proxy-list counts lines, and the same address and port is listed under more than one protocol file. Should the record also state the number of distinct address and port pairs, from a probe record that holds the three list bodies of one commit?
why: Counting the three bodies of commit f569d21 (http.txt 3441 lines, socks4.txt 2703, socks5.txt 4112, 10256 in all) gave 6332 distinct address:port strings and 3837 distinct addresses; 1969 strings are in both http.txt and socks4.txt, 1778 in both http.txt and socks5.txt, 1949 in both socks4.txt and socks5.txt, and 1772 in all three. Counting the stored files of 2026-10-24 (10430 lines) gave 7183 distinct strings. These counts are a lead, not evidence: no registered probe record holds them, because each stored page or body states the count of one file only. The measured payload share of 8 of 100 was drawn over lines, so a pair that is listed twice could be drawn twice.
